stage: R5 DEV ONLY; frozen before ANY R5 measurement
purpose: Learn separate expected full-cold GF2 gain on complete non-grid exact-XOR, and choose between CryptoMiniSat-original and CaDiCaL-original on incomplete/mixed/non-XOR; test on fresh source SHA.

training.r4_training_warning: 13 R1-R3 original SHAs + 8 R4 original SHAs: R4 exact non-grid only TWO independent source SHAs, widths 4 and 5. This is sparse training, not evidence for all random XOR distributions.
training.data_leakage: No R5 original SHA or SAT labels or times in fit/thresholds. R4 partial-XOR4 shares parent with R4 exact XOR4; is one related class, not an independent confirmation.
training.uncertainty_handling: Non-grid GF2 route requires BOTH R4 exact non-grid width4+width5 original source groups to show >=1.25x GF2 speedup versus fastest successfully verified independent competitor at EACH of the two hosts, and incoming certified source has width 4 or 5, support-degree CV between 0.3 and 0.65, certified eq/n between 0.7 and 1.3. Otherwise fallback certified CryptoMiniSat native-XOR.
training.mixed_cnf: R4 partial XOR width4 one prior source: use CaDiCaL only for exactly one damaged parity clause and complete block fraction >=0.98 with clause widths all 4, matching training class; otherwise ordinary original CNF CryptoMiniSat. No GF2 on incomplete formulas. For ordinary 3CNF choose CryptoMiniSat original; large mixed formulas not trained -> CryptoMiniSat original.

feature_policy.validation: Only structural sign-mask grouping and parity-certificate checking; NEVER GF2 elimination, SAT solve, planted model, observed timings or R5 labels in selector.

nonapplicable_arm_policy: Native XOR and GF2 ablation MUST abstain if the entire original CNF is not an exact proven XOR cover; they never silently drop residual clauses.

frozen_gates.correctness: All new R5 selector SAT results MUST pass full original-CNF replay 3 of 3 on BOTH Ubuntu workers. No SAT model, no positive sample.
frozen_gates.independent_XOR_gain: At least TWO DISTINCT new widths 4 and 5, with each width having >=1 NEW source SHA showing >=1.20x speedup of R5 selector vs fastest FULLY VERIFIED external competing solver (CMS-native, CMS-original, CaDiCaL-original) on BOTH hosts, and no >10% regret across the other exact-XOR sources.
frozen_gates.incomplete_mixed_no_regret: No >10% regret relative fastest fully verified applicable external solver on all 6 non-exact sources on both hosts; any missing full verification -> NOT PASSED.
frozen_gates.no_censored_wins: Only baselines fully SAT-verified 3/3 can contribute to comparison. CPU/wall/timeouts right-censored. Claim strict all-baselines separately, NOT PASSED if any applicable external method fails/timeout.
frozen_gates.independent_structure_coverage: Not enough to test only 4/5 width exact; include width3/6 and mixed/partial/3CNF negatives. All source SHAs unique and disjoint from R1-R4.
frozen_gates.stage5: Even if R5 narrow full gate passes, fifth general SAT step needs independent external administrator with sealed multi-family challenge. Automatic C023 promotion PROHIBITED.

matrix.compute: existing free standard hosted runners; no paid Rowan or heavy NAS/PC
